description: Fictional October 2026 conversations for Recall & Commit. All people and events are invented.

utterances.speaker: Priya
utterances.text: Morning. So 4.2 is officially locked for the 22nd. Alex, where are we on the test plan?

utterances.speaker: Alex
utterances.text: Draft's about 70 percent there. I still need the payments section from Omar.

utterances.speaker: Omar
utterances.text: Sorry, that's on me. I'll send you the payment flows after lunch.

utterances.speaker: Priya
utterances.text: Okay. Alex, can you have the full plan in the shared drive by Friday?

utterances.speaker: Alex
utterances.text: Yes, I'll have the complete test plan in the drive by Friday at noon.

utterances.speaker: Priya
utterances.text: Perfect. Nina, anything blocking?

utterances.speaker: Nina
utterances.text: Just the login timeout bug. I'm still digging.

seed_commitments.action_text: Publish the full 4.2 test plan to the shared drive

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Hey, did you see the electric bill? It jumped like forty bucks.

utterances.speaker: Alex
utterances.text: Yeah, the AC has been running nonstop. Phoenix in October, man.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Want to just split it like usual?

utterances.speaker: Alex
utterances.text: Sure. I'll Venmo you my half tonight.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Cool. Also we're out of eggs and coffee.

utterances.speaker: Alex
utterances.text: I'm going to Fry's Saturday anyway, I'll grab both.

seed_commitments.action_text: Venmo Leo half of the electric bill

utterances.speaker: Maya
utterances.text: Okay I'm at Best Buy. The blue one is $899, the gray one is $1,049.

utterances.speaker: Alex
utterances.text: The blue laptop is cheaper, but its battery life is not good enough. I read the reviews, it's like five hours.

utterances.speaker: Maya
utterances.text: The gray model has better battery life and more storage. 512 versus 256.

utterances.speaker: Alex
utterances.text: Let's choose the gray model, even though it costs a little more. You'll be carrying it to campus all day.

utterances.speaker: Maya
utterances.text: Agreed. Gray it is. Can you help me set it up this weekend?

utterances.speaker: Alex
utterances.text: Maybe Sunday? Let me see how Saturday goes first.

utterances.speaker: Maya
utterances.text: No rush.

utterances.speaker: Nina
utterances.text: I think I found it. The session refresh fires twice when the tab sleeps.

utterances.speaker: Alex
utterances.text: That matches what I saw. It only repros after about 20 minutes idle.

utterances.speaker: Nina
utterances.text: I'll push a fix to staging by Monday morning.

utterances.speaker: Alex
utterances.text: Great. Once it's on staging I'll run the idle-session tests and send you the results.

utterances.speaker: Nina
utterances.text: Thanks. Ping me if it still logs you out.

seed_commitments.action_text: Run the idle-session tests on Nina's login fix and send her the results
seed_commitments.due_text: after the fix lands on staging
